_doc: Recurrent / scan op class (A2 capabilities item 2). Offered only for slots of class `recurrent`, which ModelBlaster emits for gru_seq / lstm_seq / lstm when `--recurrent-class on` ($MB_RECURRENT_CLASS=1); with the flag off these ops are class `gemm` and none of these entries applies. Evidence: l3_farm/analysis/cuda_vs_flow.md (41_GRUBidirectional): the fast kernels are latency-bound per timestep (about 1,650 cycles per step: ~640 waiting on L2 for other blocks' h, ~215 mma + barrier, ~600 gate math + publish); GEMM-tiling labels (memory_coalescing, split_k) did not fit.

techniques.mechanism: one persistent launch runs all T timesteps; each block owns a slice of hidden units and keeps its W_hh slice resident (registers as mma fragments, or shared memory) and its h / c slice on chip across steps; only the h exchange between blocks goes through L2
risks: all blocks must be co-resident (grid <= resident capacity; size the grid with mb_sm_budget() when present, never with all SMs blindly)
register pressure from resident W_hh fragments (check ptxas spills)

realizations.how: grid = hidden slices (e.g. 16-64 blocks per direction); per step: read h_{t-1} (all blocks' slices), gates = W_hh_slice h + G_t (precomputed input projection), apply sigmoid/tanh in fp32, write the block's h_t slice, signal readiness; loop.
W_hh slice as mma.sync.m16n8k16 A-fragments loaded once into registers; h_{t-1} as B-fragments built from the exchange buffer; fp32 accumulators; gates computed directly on the accumulator fragments.

techniques.mechanism: the input projections X W_ih^T + b of all timesteps do not depend on the recurrence: compute them as one large GEMM (tensor cores, full GPU) before or overlapped with the recurrence, so each serial step only does the small h W_hh^T product
risks: needs scratch for T x B x G*H gate pre-activations (slot-owned, lazily allocated, instance-safe)
if computed inside the same launch, GEMM blocks must not starve the recurrence blocks of SMs

realizations.how: Phase 1: G = X W_ih^T + b_ih (+ b_hh for r/z) for all T as a tiled GEMM; phase 2: the T-step recurrence reads G_t. Or run GEMM-worker blocks in the same persistent launch that publish per-time-tile ready flags the recurrence waits on.
Phase-1 GEMM with mma.sync + cp.async multi-stage tiles; fold b_ih + b_hh for the r/z gates into it, keep b_hn separate (it sits inside r * (W_hn h + b_hn)).

techniques.mechanism: replace grid-wide barriers between timesteps by point-to-point readiness: each block publishes its h_t slice together with the step number (a tagged 64-bit word or a per-slice flag) and readers poll only the words they need; replicate the exchange buffer so reader warps get coalesced loads
risks: memory ordering: publish with st.release.gpu (or __threadfence before a volatile flag store), poll with ld.acquire.gpu / ld.relaxed.gpu + fence; a missing fence gives rare wrong results
spin loops deadlock if a producer block is not resident
full-mask __shfl_sync in a partial warp hangs

realizations.how: Exchange buffer word = {h pair (2 x fp16), step}: the writer stores one 64-bit word per pair, readers spin until the step field equals t. No counters to reset, no grid.sync().
st.release.gpu.b64 / ld.acquire.gpu.b64 (or ld.relaxed.gpu + fence.acq_rel.gpu); keep the spin tight (no __nanosleep on the critical path; measured: back-off polling was slower).

techniques.mechanism: independent recurrences run at the same time: the forward and reverse direction of a layer concurrently (two block groups in one launch, or two concurrent instances), and in unidirectional stacks layer l+1 step t once layer l has produced step t (a diagonal wavefront)
risks: co-residency of all concurrently spinning blocks
the slot sees only its own op: within one op only the batch / gate / direction dimensions are available; cross-op wavefronts need a region slot

realizations.how: Use few blocks per recurrence (16-32) so a concurrent sibling (the other direction, another layer) fits beside it; read mb_sm_budget() when the harness provides it and size the grid to it.

techniques.mechanism: the per-step gate math (sigmoid, tanh, the r * (.) and (1-z) h + z n blends) is on the serial critical path: use __expf / tanh.approx.f32 / fused multiply-adds, one (batch, unit) per thread, and pack outputs with shuffles
risks: approximate tanh / exp error accumulates over T steps: check the slot tolerance on the longest sequence

realizations.how: sigmoid(x) = 1 / (1 + __expf(-x)); tanh via tanh.approx.f32 inline PTX on sm_75+; keep accumulation in fp32.

techniques.mechanism: measure where a timestep's cycles go before restructuring: clock64() deltas per phase (wait for h, mma, gate math, publish) accumulated per block and reported once; then attack the largest phase
risks: probe code must be removed (or compiled out) in the final kernel; it changes timing slightly

realizations.how: Guard the probe with a macro; read the counters only in an experiment run (multi-turn experiment tool), never in the submitted slot.
